description: Durable launch-skip provenance for A1-era admitted activation labels in data/local_labels/label_admitted.json. The plan's activation-label provenance contract requires each post-R28 admitted row to 'carry the corrected --launch-skip value in its label-side metadata'; the admitted-label schema (workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/local_label_admitted.schema.json) has additionalProperties:false and no field for warmup_count / cache_control / launch_index / launch_skip, so this sidecar provides the durable link between each 7-tuple join key and the sweep config that admitted it. selected_launch_skip equals selected_warmup_count by NCU semantics (--launch-skip=N skips the first N kernel launches before profiling). Enforced by tools/local_labels/test_admitted_label_launch_provenance_scanner.py.

entries.nvbit_build_reason: Label collection used NCU only against the existing NVBit traces under workloads/simbench_bw/results/<slug>/rtx_3090_ti/sm_86/trace_<shape>/dynamic_trace.pb. Those traces were collected by the prior-loop NVBit tracer build; the durable trace sidecars record tracer_so_path but the tracer's per-build SHA is host-local and not committed. The active loop does not re-collect traces; the post-R28 NCU sweep (see sweep_dir_id) reused the existing traces. Future rounds that re-collect traces (e.g., portable_lcd Path A) MUST transition this status to 'live_capture' with the actual NVBit tracer build SHA from git rev-parse HEAD at the tracer rebuild time.
